what: On wide screens, after scrolling past 1000px, the header that sat on top of the Hero paints a background color, sticks to the top of the screen and slides down from above in .35s ease. Back above 1000px it slides up in .35s and disappears, then returns to its original flow position (transparent). Not stuck below 961px

options.dur: Duration of going down and coming up (sec), default .35 — 0 snaps it on instantly
options.wide: Applied only at this width (px) or above, default 961
options.out: Duration (s) for going up, default dur — differs from coming down, like brand
options.look: fade: Rises and falls while opacity also goes 0↔1 (brand)
options.--fx-shift: Position before coming down · after going up (via style), default -100% (its own height) — Brand shrinks in height 90→70 as it attaches, so -100px
options.round: When on, the header is attached to the screen from the start (position fixed), and each time the type changes the current type drops out upward (out) and the new type (is-docked present or absent) comes down (dur) — scrolling down just a little from the top removes the transparent header and brings down a low header with a background, and returning to the top has it drop out again and come down in the transparent type. If scroll changes while it is leaving, only the type coming down is corrected

note: Adds is-docked when it sticks, is-dock-in when it comes down and is-dock-out when it goes up. To turn the white hero heading dark while it is stuck, the consuming side selects with :not(.is-docked).

from.where: shared.js fixed header .jb-h.is-min (original #js-headclone — scrolling down past 500px (750px in the recruit section) runs TweenLite.fromTo .5s Circ.easeOut y −height·alpha 0 → 0·1, and on return .2s to y −height·alpha 0) — after: 500; dur: .5; out: .2; wide: 881; look: fade; style="--fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1); --fx-ease-out: cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)". The original kept the flow header and pasted in one more copy of the same header

shared.js .gb-header (original app.js — past 400px it becomes fixed with .scrolling, a white .9 panel, height 90→70. In between (header height to 400) it is hidden with translateY(−100px) and slides down with transition all .3s ease-in-out. On the way back position is released immediately with no animation, and it sticks on phones too)
